rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not confirm changes before executing them, and appears to have modified a pending order’s air purifier even though the user said the purifier was already received (should have been an exchange on a delivered order). The agent also failed to address the requested address change for the watch order and the silicone-to-metal (white) watch modification. Additionally, it stated a price difference would be charged without evidence from tools. These violate the policy and the request was not fully completed.
